title: New Update Available

sections.name: Product monitoring
items: Exact Pokémon Center SKUs are now checked against the official search result in an isolated hidden monitor window.
Tasks no longer depend on the empty central source list to verify an explicitly entered SKU.
Official SKU checks are deduplicated across tasks and repeat every 30 seconds while a task remains active.

sections.name: Status reliability
items: A verified in-stock exact SKU advances from Monitoring to Found even when Auto-apply match is disabled.
Out-of-stock products remain Monitoring with an unavailable message, and unmatched SKUs show a clear retry message.
The matched product name and official product URL are written back to the task row.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
